messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-runtime kvcache cluster-3 reporting OOMs and elevated 5xxs across continuous-batching pools. 3 nodes in pool-3 tripped OOM within last 7m. Auto-eviction triggered.
monica: oncall here, investigating. which tenants first? any customer impact noted?
raj: seeing spikes from long_prompt workload (sessions with >200k tokens). KV cache growth per-session ~linear, batch window causing accumulation. metrics: kvcache_mem_used +140% over baseline in 5m.
lucy: adding logs: ``ERROR runtime: evict failure: out of memory, allocate 2048M`` from node-gpu-3a. stack shows prefetch + continuous-batcher allocs.
sara: tagging impacted customers: taxi-ops, docs-search, and demo-sandbox. small % of requests returning 5xx or timing out. CS already notified for taxi-ops.
dan: quick mitigation suggestion: cut prefetch depth & cap per-session kv. We can flip the runtime feature flag prefetch.max_keys -> 256 and prefetch.max_bytes -> 1e6.
emily: +1 to cap. also reduce batch window from 200ms -> 50ms to avoid compounding KV holds. quick config patch:
```
# kvcache runtime flags
prefetch.max_keys=256
prefetch.max_bytes=1000000
batching.window_ms=50
```
lucy: deploying hotpatch to canary (pool-3a) now. running: `kubectl -n runtime set env ds/kvcache-runtime PREFETCH_MAX_BYTES=1000000 PREFETCH_MAX_KEYS=256 BATCHING_WINDOW_MS=50 --record`
monica: @lucy keep canary for 2 minutes, if stable promote to pool-3. Watch kvcache_evictions/sec and oom_count.
incident-bot: Canary deploy started at 1719456835. Monitoring hook attached: perf-alerts and paging channel.
lucy: Canary green after 90s. mem usage on canary down ~48%, no new OOMs. promoting to rest of pool-3.
raj: promoting now. pushing config to all runtime replicas. rolling update in progress.
emily: rolling update finished. post-deploy metrics: kvcache_mem_used back to baseline, OOMs stopped, 5xx rate down from 3.7% -> 0.6%. latency slightly improved.
matt: customer impact summary: taxi-ops saw 18 minutes of degraded responses (5xx + increased latency). no data loss. docs-search had intermittent errors for 12 minutes. status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1719456789 (short note).
sara: I already pinged taxi-ops PM; they asked for ETA on root cause. will prepare comms once postmortem has RCA and timeline.
dan: root cause hypothesis: runaway prefetch + larger-than-expected long-context inputs hit continuous-batching path, kvref counts never trimmed between batches, causing per-session memory accumulation and eventual OOM.
monica: next steps: 1) schedule postmortem (owners: dan, raj, lucy). 2) create permanent guardrail: enforce session-level context cap + prefetch circuit breaker. 3) add unit & load test for extreme long_prompt traces.
emily: added ticket INF-2319 for guardrail + tests. dan created RFC for better kv lifecycle.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: incident declared resolved at 1719456912 after cluster metrics normalized. please follow the post-incident workflow. :white_check_mark:
